topic: Understanding and Manipulating the C Memory Model and Storage Classes for Advanced Memory Management
explanation: In advanced C programming, a deep understanding of the C memory model and storage classes (auto, static, extern, register) is essential for precise control over variable lifetime, linkage, and storage duration. Mastery of these concepts enables developers to optimize memory usage, implement complex data sharing patterns, and avoid subtle bugs related to variable scope and lifetime, especially in systems programming, embedded development, or performance-critical applications.
